solver: fmmax via inverse/model.py bilayer_t, CPU (4 processes x 4 cores)

shifts: 16 x 16 grid, 45 C4v-distinct shifts computed (part*.npz), the rest by J(g delta) = M_g J M_g^T (lpa_jones.npz, J[i, j, lam, out, in])
